Dilshan Madushanka, left-arm fast medium, comes into the attack
Dilshan Madushanka to Tom Banton, wide, 131kph, some inward movement for the left-arm seamer, but it starts down the leg side as Banton misses the clip. Not much bounce on offer so far
Dilshan Madushanka to Tom Banton, FOUR, beautifully timed! Another one coming in, but it’s on the pads. Banton flicks it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for four. That was timed to perfection
Dilshan Madushanka to Tom Banton, wide, sprays it down the leg once again, Mendis dives to his left to stop the ball
Dilshan Madushanka to Tom Banton, no run, 135kph, close to off stump. Banton sees it slightly away from the off stump and shoulders arms

Dilshan Madushanka to Tom Banton, no run, much better from Dilshan Madushanka! Hits a good length with some inward movement and keeps it on off stump. Banton blocks it to the left of the bowler who stretches out his left hand and stops the ball
Dilshan Madushanka to Tom Banton, no run, Tom Banton turns this back of a length delivery to square leg
Dilshan Madushanka to Tom Banton, 1 run, on length this time around and Tom Banton pushes it to the left of the cover fielder for a single
Dilshan Madushanka to Ben Duckett, no run, full and swinging away but the line is outside off, Ben Duckett leaves it alone
Asitha Fernando to Tom Banton, no run, blocks this length delivery off the back foot

Asitha Fernando to Tom Banton, FOUR, slanting into the pads from back of a length. Banton stays deep in the crease and tucks it towards deep backward square leg, where the fielder fails to get low enough and lets it slip through for four. Poor effort in the field
Asitha Fernando to Tom Banton, no run, stays low a bit from the length but Tom Banton still knocks it off the back foot

Asitha Fernando to Tom Banton, no run, oh, that one held up off the surface! Slightly short of a good length, and Banton somehow manages to keep it down as the ball rolls back to the bowler on the bounce
Asitha Fernando to Tom Banton, THATS OUT!! Bowled!!

Asitha Fernando to Tom Banton, out Bowled!! That's a beauty from Asitha Fernando! A superb away-swinger does the trick. He hits a probing length and gets the ball to move away late. Banton plays down the wrong line, the ball beats the outside edge and crashes into the top of off. A disappointing outing for Banton after being promoted up the order. Tom Banton b Asitha Fernando 10(12) [4s-2]
Joe Root, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Asitha Fernando to Root, no run, stays deep in the crease and dead bats this short of a good length delivery into the surface
Dilshan Madushanka to Ben Duckett, no run, 133kph and keeps it outside off with some away movement, Ben Duckett brings his bat down and pushes it to his left
Dilshan Madushanka to Ben Duckett, no run
Dilshan Madushanka to Ben Duckett, no run
Asitha Fernando to Ben Duckett, no run, fullish outside off, Ben Duckett drives it straight to the fielder at extra cover
Asitha Fernando to Ben Duckett, no run, width on offer, but it stays a touch low. Duckett attempts a cut, but the ball sneaks under his bat and goes through to the keeper on the bounce
Dilshan Madushanka to Ben Duckett, 1 run, to mid-wicket
Dilshan Madushanka to Root, no run, full and moving away with the angle, tempting Root into the drive, but he resists the temptation and lets it go through
Dilshan Madushanka to Root, no run
Asitha Fernando to Ben Duckett, no run
Asitha Fernando to Ben Duckett, no run
Asitha Fernando to Ben Duckett, 1 run, to backward square leg
